mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_chat_session (user_id, title, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, create_time, update_time FROM t_chat_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY update_time DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_chat_session SET update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_chat_session WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_chat_session WHERE user_id = #{userId}
